already_linked.message: This code review is already linked to issue <issue_id>.
already_linked.raised_when: legacy GithubPullRequestLink, path-scope GitCodeReviewLink, repo-scope link, or IntegrityError-race reread belongs to a different issue (code_reviews.py:176-177,211-212,226,259-260)

github_legacy_state_mapping.source: integrations/git/code_reviews.py:78-82 (_ensure_github_legacy_link update path) and 96-100 (create path) — GithubPullRequestLink.State has no MERGED value, so MERGED collapses to CLOSED

link_lookup_order: path-scope GitCodeReviewLink by (provider, host_url, namespace, repo_name, external_iid) newest first
repo-scope link by (provider, host_url, external_iid, repo_external_id) or path+empty repo_external_id
create with lowercased namespace/repo_name, snapshot title truncated to 500 chars (code_reviews.py:190,236)
